# How to make an AI character monologue with multiple camera angles

**One still becomes four angles, one acted voice track is cut at the pauses, and each part is lip-synced to its own angle.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_a9b7dde96277.webp" alt="An old wizard in an open-plan office complains to the camera about the printer, cut from a front angle to a side close-up with the lips on the words." width="480"></p>

Make a one-minute character monologue that plays like a filmed scene: one base still, three more camera angles of the same moment, one voice track with acting tags, the audio cut into parts under 15 seconds at the pauses, each part lip-synced to its own angle with a performance prompt, then an edit that changes angle on every part. Includes the angle prompts, the voice script format with bracketed directions, the per-shot performance prompt, the varg calls and the checks. Use when someone wants a character to deliver a speech, rant, confession, villain monologue, "explains X in character" sketch, parody address or documentary-style interview with consistent face and voice for 30 to 90 seconds, or says their talking AI character looks like a frozen avatar. For a remake of an existing scene use scene-recast-video; for the joke and the rules for real people use ai-parody-video; for a two-host show use varg-podcast-video.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill multi-angle-monologue                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills multi-angle-monologue --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 30-90 s monologue MP4 cut across four angles |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | under $2 for stills and voice, plus 6-12 lip-synced parts (estimate first) |
| Uses | varg API, Nano Banana 2.1, ElevenLabs v4, MiniMax H3 Max, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 60-second villain monologue about spreadsheets from ./character.png, four camera angles, 16:9"
- "Write the speech with acting tags, cut the audio under 15 seconds at the pauses and lip-sync each part to a different angle"
- "My talking character looks like a frozen avatar. Rebuild it as a scene with angle changes"
